en.headline: Long Win bus hits railing at Airport Skycity terminus, no one injured
en.dek: Police said the bus appeared to have lost control at a turning point around 2.49pm on Sunday, damaging about 10 metres of railing and the front of the vehicle.
body: A Long Win bus crashed into a railing inside the Airport Skycity bus terminus on Sunday afternoon, leaving the front of the vehicle heavily damaged but with no injuries reported.

Police received a report at about 2.49pm that a bus had lost control at a turning point inside the terminus and struck approximately 10 metres of metal railing. Photographs circulating online showed the bumper detached, parts exposed and the front wheels turned sharply to the right, while the railing was twisted out of shape.

Preliminary information suggested the driver may have pressed the accelerator instead of the brake. Officers attended the scene and are investigating the cause. Long Win Bus has been approached for comment.
The terminus serves routes connecting the airport area. No passengers or staff were hurt in the incident.

zh.headline: 龍運巴士航天城總站疑失控撞毀欄杆 車頭嚴重損毀無人受傷
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時49分接報，巴士在總站轉彎位撞毀約10米鐵欄，車頭泵把脫落，事件中無人受傷。
body: 一輛龍運巴士今午在機場航天城巴士總站內疑失控撞毀欄杆，車頭嚴重損毀，幸無人受傷。
警方指下午約2時49分接獲報案，指一輛巴士在總站轉彎位失控，撞毀約10米鐵欄後停下。網上圖片顯示，涉事巴士車頭泵把脫落、零件外露，頭輪大幅度扭向右邊，鐵欄則被撞至扭曲變形。
初步相信車長可能踩錯油門肇事。警方現正調查事件成因，並已到場處理。《香港01》正就事件向營運商查詢。
航天城總站服務機場一帶路線。事件中沒有乘客或職員受傷。
